subject: Communication
title: Ethnocentrism: The Default Bias
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ethnocentrism: The Default Bias.

hook.text: Every culture thinks it's normal and others are strange. That's not an insult — it's a cognitive default called ethnocentrism.

buildup.text: Ethnocentrism means judging other cultures by the standards of your own — often unconsciously.

discovery.text: It's evolutionarily wired: in-group preference helped survival.

twist.text: The antidote isn't cultural relativism (all practices are equal). It's cultural humility: 'My way isn't the only way.'

climax.text: Moving from ethnocentrism to ethnorelativism — appreciating other cultural logics — is a process, not a switch to flip.

punchline.text: Your normal is someone else's strange. And vice versa.

quiz.question: What is ethnocentrism?
options: Judging other cultures by your own standards
